name: Park Bench Apparel
old_description: Was established in 2003 beginning with screen printing and embroidery services near Rapid City, South Dakota.
about:
Park Bench Apparel operates from Black Hawk, South Dakota, near Rapid City. The business was established in 2003 as A&J Screening, starting with screen printing and embroidery services before expanding into a broader range of creative production.

Today the company provides screen printing up to 14 colors, heat transfers using UAF Aqua Fusion technology, embroidery, appliqué, laser engraving and cutting, UV printing, wide-format printing, stickers and decals, graphic design and web store setup, dye-sublimation cut-and-sew uniforms, white-label printing and shipping, and bagging, folding, and UPC finishing. The production crew and designers bring decades of combined experience, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Clients include sports organizations such as the Rush Hockey program and events like the Lakota Nation Invitational, along with businesses seeking custom apparel, promotional products, and uniform programs. The white-label fulfillment service targets brands and retailers that need outsourced production and shipping.

The company emphasizes fresh, original designs and streamlined fulfillment through its white-label offering, positioning itself as a single source for decorated apparel and branded merchandise.
